title: Rungrado 1st of May Stadium
geometryBasis: The native stadium envelope contains 154 perimeter vertices. A separate mapped pitch ring provides the alignment and dimensions for the open bowl.
sectionBasis: The exact Qualla crop supports the hanging pale roof silhouette and recessed facade. The eyewitness account records sixteen arches and the roof zenith at 60 metres. The unaltered Copernicus surface field includes the island, rivers and parts of the real roof.
limitations: Roof seam paths, lower facade articulation, modern cladding colors, stand sections and track dimensions are estimates. The pitch orientation and perimeter are mapped.

The roofed stands cover an open field and running track. The original Copernicus surface has roof imprint around the stadium and can obscure its lower interior in the unmasked terrain view. Field height and foundation grade are approximate.
